 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 29.07.2024
P.C. :
1] Heard.  Issue notice to the respondents in both applications, returnable on 8th August, 2024. The learned APP waives notice on behalf the respondent-State. 
2] In the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with Crime No.378/2024 registered with Ahmedpur Police Station, Tq.Ahmedpur, District Latur, for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of 1280.24ABA the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, they be released on anticipatory bail on executing personal bond of Irfan @ Bablu Mainoddin Pathan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 29 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125205613/
1 Rs.20,000/- each with one surety in the like amount by each of them. Applicants shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
